Definition: of Hebrew origin (H948); white linen:--fine linen.
BiblicalUsage: býssos is simply fine white linen. Scripture uses it in Luke, and the context leaves nothing to guess at.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that býssos is no exception: no word in Scripture is filler.
